question.text: Consider the P-V diagram for 1 mole of an ideal monatomic gas shown in the figure. Which of the following statements is/are true?

options.text: The change in internal energy for the whole process is zero
Heat is rejected during the process
Change in internal energy for process $A \rightarrow B$ is $-\frac{3}{2} P_{0} V_{0}$
Work done by the gas during the entire process is $2 \mathrm{P}_{0} \mathrm{~V}_{0}$

solution.text: $$ \begin{array}{l} \Delta \mathrm{U}=\mathrm{n} \mathrm{Cv} \Delta \mathrm{T} \\ \Delta \mathrm{T}=\frac{\mathrm{P}_{\mathrm{c}} \mathrm{V}_{\mathrm{c}}}{\mathrm{nR}}-\frac{\mathrm{P}_{\mathrm{A}} \mathrm{V}_{\mathrm{A}}}{\mathrm{nR}}=0 \end{array} $$ Hence $\Delta \mathrm{U}=0$ (option $\mathrm{A}$ is correct) $$ \begin{array}{l} \Delta \mathrm{Q}=\Delta \mathrm{U}+\text { work } \\ \Delta \mathrm{U}=0, \text { work }=(-) \end{array} $$ $\Rightarrow \Delta Q=(-)$; Hence heat is rejected during the process (option B is correct) for process $A B$ $\Delta \mathrm{U}=\mathrm{nC}_{\mathrm{v}}\left(\frac{\mathrm{P}_{\mathrm{C}} \mathrm{V}_{\mathrm{B}}}{\mathrm{nR}}-\frac{\mathrm{P}_{\mathrm{A}} \mathrm{V}_{\mathrm{A}}}{\mathrm{nR}}\right)=\frac{3 \mathrm{R}}{2}\left(\frac{\mathrm{P}_{0} \mathrm{~V}_{0}}{\mathrm{R}}-\frac{\mathrm{P}_{0} 2 \mathrm{~V}_{0}}{\mathrm{R}}\right)=-\frac{3}{2} \mathrm{P}_{0} \mathrm{~V}_{0}$ (option $\mathrm{C}$ is correct) during entire process work done by gas is $-P_{0} V_{0} \quad$ (option $D$ is correct)
